timeline.summary: Kaya rides Cosima's longship through the Cosmos and learns from Inga about Omenpaths and Doomskars.
timeline.quote: It was the Doomskars people feared, though—celestial collisions that seemed invariably to lead to calamity.

citation.work: Episode 2: Awaken the Trolls
citation.text: "Episode 2: Awaken the Trolls" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tibalt, narrating, boasts that his plotting will set Kaldheim ablaze, and tells the saga of a planeswalker named Tibalt.
timeline.quote: all of Kaldheim would be improved with a touch more fire, a dash of anarchy

citation.work: Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: The Horrible Beast poisons Tibalt with a seed and forces him to cause a distraction, though Tibalt had already planned to stir up trouble.
timeline.quote: the Horrible Beast snuck up on him one day and stuck Tibalt with a nasty, tricky sort of poison

citation.work: Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tibalt tricks Valki, the God of Lies, to use him as a disguise.
timeline.quote: It happened that this God of Lies, this Prince of Tricksters, was foolish enough to get lied to and tricked himself.

citation.work: Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Disguised as Valki, Tibalt visits Koll the Forgemaster, who refuses to hand over the Sword of the Realms, and pushes him into his forge.
timeline.quote: so Tibalt did the realms a favor and pushed the obnoxious dwarf right into his own forge

citation.work: Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tibalt stirs trouble in Surtland and Bretagard, warning frost giants of trolls and promising the Skelle the return of Varragoth.
timeline.quote: Tibalt sowed the seeds of war and chaos

citation.work: Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt

timeline.summary: The fleet passes through the Cosmos and flies toward the Invasion Tree with valkyries.

timeline.summary: On Kaldheim, Harald counts the minutes until his brother Tyvar bursts from the sea clinging to a serpent's head.
timeline.quote: On the count of three hundred thirteen, Tyvar Kell bursts from the water clinging to the serpent's engorged head.

timeline.summary: On Kaldheim, Tyvar fights a lone wolf and knocks it back with a stone-fisted punch.
timeline.quote: The wolf, which was easily twice his size, leapt, and Tyvar swung a mighty left hook at the soft underside of its jaw

timeline.summary: Tyvar vouches for Niko Aris, a former planeswalker, as the defensive fighter Kaito needs.
timeline.quote: I think I may have just the hero that you need

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Niko splits Trygve's thrown axe, and then their own, with two throws.
timeline.quote: The first struck the handle of Trygve's axe, splitting it lengthwise.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Niko shows their shard magic, says the invasion did not take it, and agrees to come along.
timeline.quote: Can't let the Planeswalkers have all the fun.

timeline.quote: Tyvar swore to become a storied hero in his own right and traveled the realms seeking adventure
